results.q: How can I trust a new friend on the Circles App?
results.a:
Trusting a new Circles friend is easy. 

1. Simply click on your profile picture to access the quick action menu




2. click "Trust New Friend" to search for the friend you wish to add




3. click on "their profile"




4. click on the "arrow button"




5. Trust Successful screen will pop-up

results.q: Who can I invite to use Circles?
results.a: During the research phase of the Circles Project only Vendors will be able to invite new users.

results.q: I can't find a person I want to add as one of my Circles Friends on the application. Is there another way I can add them?
results.a: There are 3 different ways you can add a new Circles contact. As well as searching for their name, you can also scan their profile's QR code or they can send you their Circles ID address via another chat platform (WA, Facebook etc.)

results.q: Can I add a Circles contact from outside of my area?
results.a: Yes you can, however it's important that you know and trust them before you do. Before adding anyone to your contact, make sure that they have the correct name and profile picture, otherwise you are at risk of adding a fake or inactive users, and any Circles Points you get from them may not be useful for you.

results.q: Can I remove someone from my Circles contacts?
results.a:
The contacts section shows all the people that you trust, if you stop trusting someone you should remove them by:

1. Click on their profile




2. Click “untrust”.

results.q: How do I invite someone to join Circles?
results.a:
You can send an invite link to invite someone new to join the Circles platform. 






But it's important that you know and trust them before inviting them as otherwise any Circles Points you get from them may not be useful.
